claims.span: Ablation results indicate that both components contribute to Larchmont-GNN's performance
claims.proposition: The ablation results indicate that ring-aware pooling and distance features both contribute to Larchmont-GNN's performance.

claims.span: removing ring-aware pooling reduced average ROC-AUC from 79.4 to 78.7
claims.proposition: Removing ring-aware pooling from Larchmont-GNN reduced its average ROC-AUC from 79.4 to 78.7.
Removing distance features from Larchmont-GNN reduced its average ROC-AUC to 78.9.
Removing both ring-aware pooling and distance features from Larchmont-GNN reduced its average ROC-AUC to 78.0.

claims.span: Avonlea-Chem-XL, which achieved a higher average ROC-AUC (80.0 vs 79.4)
claims.proposition: Avonlea-Chem-XL achieved a higher average ROC-AUC than Larchmont-GNN, 80.0 versus 79.4.

claims.span: was higher on five of six datasets
claims.proposition: Avonlea-Chem-XL's ROC-AUC was higher than Larchmont-GNN's on five of the six datasets.
On Hollin-Sol, Larchmont-GNN achieved a higher ROC-AUC than Avonlea-Chem-XL, 84.1 versus 83.5.

claims.span: Across the six scaffold-split datasets, Larchmont-GNN achieved a higher average test ROC-AUC than Quintrell-MP (79.4 vs 78.4)
claims.proposition: Across the six scaffold-split datasets, Larchmont-GNN achieved a higher average test ROC-AUC than Quintrell-MP, 79.4 versus 78.4.

claims.span: outperformed it on five of the six datasets
claims.proposition: Larchmont-GNN outperformed Quintrell-MP on five of the six datasets.

claims.span: with a small margin on Lumley-Metab (69.8 vs 69.5)
claims.proposition: Larchmont-GNN outperformed Quintrell-MP by a small ROC-AUC margin on Lumley-Metab, 69.8 versus 69.5.

claims.span: Larchmont-GNN (4.8M parameters, 210 ms per 1,000 molecules) is slightly larger and slower than Quintrell-MP (4.1M, 180 ms)
claims.proposition: Larchmont-GNN is slightly larger than Quintrell-MP, with 4.8M versus 4.1M parameters.

claims.span: Larchmont-GNN (4.8M parameters, 210 ms per 1,000 molecules) is slightly larger and slower than Quintrell-MP (4.1M, 180 ms)
claims.proposition: Larchmont-GNN is slower than Quintrell-MP, requiring 210 ms versus 180 ms of inference time per 1,000 molecules.

claims.span: far more efficient than Avonlea-Chem-XL (310M, 2950 ms)
claims.proposition: Larchmont-GNN is far more parameter-efficient than Avonlea-Chem-XL, which has 310M parameters.

claims.span: far more efficient than Avonlea-Chem-XL (310M, 2950 ms)
claims.proposition: Larchmont-GNN is far more inference-efficient than Avonlea-Chem-XL, whose inference time is 2950 ms per 1,000 molecules.

claims.span: unlike the pretrained model, it requires no pretraining cost
claims.proposition: Unlike the pretrained Avonlea-Chem-XL model, Larchmont-GNN requires no pretraining cost.
